cases.title: Featured story: Grandpa, 82, takes Benadryl, oxybutynin and Ativan
cases.text:
Benadryl 25 mg at bedtime
Oxybutynin 5 mg twice daily
Ativan 0.5 mg at bedtime
Donepezil 10 mg daily

cases.title: Mom, 84, has dementia
cases.text:
Tylenol PM 2 caplets at bedtime
Oxybutynin 5 mg twice daily
Donepezil 10 mg daily
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Benadryl 25 mg as needed for itching

cases.title: Dad, 79, had a fall this year
cases.text:
Zolpidem 10 mg at bedtime
Oxycodone 5 mg every 6 hours as needed
Gabapentin 300 mg three times daily
Sertraline 50 mg daily
Meclizine 25 mg as needed for dizziness

cases.title: Aunt Rose, 72, no memory problems
cases.text:
Atorvastatin 20 mg at night
Amlodipine 5 mg daily
Omeprazole 20 mg daily
Aspirin 81 mg daily
Loratadine 10 mg daily
